title: hook-config — UPSTREAM BASE (authored by Anthropic/Claude Code, not by IS)
description: The upstream projection of the hook-config contract: a single hook-handler entry from a hooks.json / settings.json hooks block, owned by Claude Code. THIS FILE IS A VENDORED PROJECTION — it encodes ONLY what the upstream documents, never an IS-specific rule. IS-specific required fields and constraints live in is-overlay/hook-config.v1.json. Convergence (upstream makes one of our overlay extras required) is a mechanical MOVE of a field from is-overlay → here, not an in-place re-edit. Note the projection: the live Claude Code hooks block is a 3-level nesting (event → [{matcher, hooks:[handler...]}]); the IS contract (and the corpus, plan 033 § 14.21) FLATTEN a single hook to one entry carrying its event + matcher + handler fields, so a contract validates one hook at a time. A command handler requires a `command` (the type-specific required field); `type` selects the handler kind; `event` + `matcher` scope when it fires.
$comment: PROVENANCE. Authorities (registry contract 'hook-config' primary surfaces): code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (Hook lifecycle event table + the per-handler field tables, exit-code-2 blocking semantics); code.claude.com/docs/en/settings (hooks block placement). Captured 2026-06-11 from code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks; no vendored deep-capture exists yet (registry vendored=null) — a vendored reconciliation is a PUBLISHED-promotion precondition (DR-049). VERBATIM upstream facts encoded here, projected to the FLATTENED single-hook corpus shape: (1) event = string enum from the documented Hook lifecycle table — the full set is {SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PermissionDenied, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, Notification, MessageDisplay, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, Stop, StopFailure, TeammateIdle, InstructionsLoaded, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, PreCompact, PostCompact, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, SessionEnd}; the corpus exercises PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart and constraint-event-invalid rejects 'NotAnEvent'. (2) matcher = string scoping the hook ('*'/''/omitted match all; letters/digits/_/| = exact-or-list; otherwise a JS regex). The corpus treats matcher as required + non-empty (constraint-matcher-empty supplies ''); the upstream allows omission for match-all, but the IS contract (corpus) requires an explicit matcher. (3) type = string enum, the handler kind: {command, http, mcp_tool, prompt, agent} (verbatim from the doc); the corpus uses 'command' and constraint-type-invalid rejects 'sorcery'. (4) command = string, the type-specific REQUIRED field for a command handler; non-empty (the corpus constraint-command-empty supplies ''; type-command supplies an array). NOTE: no `name` field — a hook handler has no public identifier, so the universal securityChecks name/reserved-word fold simply does not fire on this contract (correct: a hook is not a named artifact). NOTE: description length is NOT capped here — the universal disclosureMarkers fold (1536) is the operative IS cap. NOTE: metadata is a generic vendor-namespaced object (the corpus edge-02-extra-optional-metadata fixture exercises this).

event.$comment: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (Hook lifecycle table): the event that triggers the hook. Enumerated as the full documented event set; the corpus uses PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart and constraint-event-invalid rejects 'NotAnEvent' (type-event supplies a number).

matcher.$comment: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: scopes when the hook fires (matches tool_name for tool events, the start reason for SessionStart, etc.). The upstream permits omission/'' for match-all; the IS contract requires an explicit non-empty matcher (the corpus constraint-matcher-empty negative supplies '').

type.$comment: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: the handler kind — verbatim enum {command, http, mcp_tool, prompt, agent}. The corpus uses 'command' and constraint-type-invalid rejects 'sorcery' (type-event/etc. cover the others).

command.$comment: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks: the type-specific REQUIRED field for a command handler (the shell command to run). Non-empty (the corpus constraint-command-empty supplies ''; type-command supplies an array). No length cap.

metadata.$comment: Vendor-namespaced extension object (e.g. metadata.intent-solutions), mirroring Claude Code's tolerance of unrecognized fields. Left as a generic object. The corpus edge-02-extra-optional-metadata fixture exercises this.
